30-Min Gym Upper Body

Chest · Lats · Shoulders — 7 exercises · ~30 min · 3 blocks

ChestLatsShoulders
Warm-up (2 min): arm circles, band pull-aparts or light dumbbells, then 1 ramp set of the first press (empty-ish → working weight). Pace: ~60 s rest on compounds, 45 s on isolations. Whole session ≈ 30 min.
CHEST

Chest

Push day: start heavy, finishe with volume. Lower every rep in ~2s.

Dumbbell Overhead Press

DELTS

3 × 8–12

    ['Standing or seated, dumbbells at shoulder height, core braced.', 'Press up + slightly back to full lockout.', 'Control descent to ear height; no lower-back arch.']

Rest: 60 s

2

Dumbbell Lateral Raise

DELTS

2 × 12–15

    ['Slight elbow bend, dumbbells at sides.', 'Lead with elbows, raise to shoulder height, pause.', 'Lower 2–3 s. Light weight, strict form — burn, not swing.']

Rest: 45 s

Dumbbell Biceps Curl

DELTS

2 × 12–15

    ['Elbows pinned, curl without swinging.', 'Squeeze at top, lower slowly.', 'Superset with lateral raises: alternate, no extra rest.']

Rest: 45 s

Run it well

  • Pick weights where the last 2 reps of every set are hard — that's growth.
  • Every negative (lowering phase) ~2–3 s. No bouncing.
  • Stuck for time? Drop block C to 2 exercises (press + lateral raise).
  • Protein within 2 h after; you're on a cut — keep the pump, keep the deficit.
